study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective registry
outcome: Repeat cesarean for arrest disorders prior to active labor (cervical dilation < 6 cm)
cohort: Women undergoing TOLAC with one prior cesarean and a singleton, term gestation who had a repeat cesarean for an arrest disorder (n=2,098)
finding: Obese women were more likely to undergo repeat cesarean prior to active labor despite receiving interventions such as longer labors and higher maximum doses of oxytocin for longer durations.
mod_finding: Obese women were more likely to undergo repeat cesarean section prior to active labor despite receiving interventions to achieve vaginal birth.
